meaning: Multi-agent code-review council benchmark on K = 4 latent root causes across 5 model families: Phase 1 separates a collapsing consensus prompt (S = 1, collision floor K - 1 = 3 > 0 and disjoint PoE collapse D_PoE = 0 -> L = 1, E_g = 0, Delta_E = -1), Phase 2 separates a binary pass/block escalation tag (S = 2 < 4, collision floor K - 2 = 2 > 0 -> L = 1, E_g = 0, Delta_E = -1), and Phase 3 verifies a disagreement-preserving side-channel schema with S = 4 >= K and shared remediation support (collision floor 0, D_PoE = 3/8 > 0 -> L = 1, E_g = 1, Delta_E = 0).
